card.name: Format letters after a percent sign
card.fires_on: Single-letter format codes right after a % or # in man-page style text, such as date format strings (%T, %e) and citation tags (%0, %T, %D).

modes.label: Date format codes
modes.description: Letter after % inside a date or printf format string in a man page.
modes.example: date +"%a %b %e %<<T>> %Y" The date and time written

modes.label: Citation tags
modes.description: Code after % in a reference record listing fields like title, author and date.
modes.example: Last Modified: December 22, 2011 %<<0>> Computer Program %A Christian, Wolfgang %

modes.label: Base codes and commands
modes.description: A single letter after # or : in technical documentation.

card.plain: It fires on the single letter that follows a percent sign or similar symbol in computer manual text.
evidence: date +"%a %b %e %<<T>> %Y" The date and time written
